title: hello I LOVE @The Jimmy Awards. the future of broadway is BRIGHT!!!!!...
transcript: It's the best day of the year. The National High School Musical Theatre Awards, also known as the Jimmys. If you follow theatre, you've probably heard of the Jimmy Awards. You've seen the iconic character medleys or watch a clip of your favourite Broadway star singing a finalist. Hello. But being there in person is something everyone should get to experience because the vibes are so good and the cheers are so loud. It is the most supportive, excited room ever. This year, there were 116 Jimmy's kids, with 40 who got to do character medleys and eight finalists. Bowen Yang was the host, obviously, he was perfect. Intermission update. I can't stop trying. They're so good. I love the teams. Everyone's amazing. I love it so much. I honestly don't know how these judges do it because every single performer was so talented. But two winners were in fact picked. Jake James from Georgia and Sammy Passetta from Arizona. This was her third Jimmy Awards, which is incredible. There were also other awards like Best Vocalist and Best Dancer. And the spirit of the Jimmy's. Every time someone won an award, the entire Jimmy's class would freak out in joy for them. It was so supportive and lovely. We then headed over to the after party at the Hard Rock Cafe. My friend Rebecca was taking all the photos. She's amazing. I was her stand in so she could get the light. And then everyone just came on through getting Their physical awards, getting their picture taken. So many proud parents, so many excited friends, and everyone was just so happy. Listen to these cheers. Literally cried about 15 times. Future of musical theater is endlessly bright, and I'm thankful I got to be there. Now go watch all the character medleys. So Jimmy's already posted them. They're just the best.
